items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Joe Loco was my piano player.

ctx.x: ... okay. Macho in 1954, in the beginning of '55, you and Joe Loco were involved in "Mambo U.S.A." Do you remember anything about that concert tour?
Very, very interesting because Joe Loco was my piano player. I know from one note to another, as soon as he was going to put the finger I know what is going to sound ......
But there were other things.... but, he had his own band at the time.....
